excerpt: four Large-Sized Telescopes in the northern hemisphere for its low-energy range (20 GeV to 3 TeV); up to 23 Medium-Sized Telescopes distributed over both array sites (80 GeV to 50 TeV); up to 37 Small-Sized Telescopes in the southern hemisphere (above 2 TeV); energies between 20 GeV and 300 TeV.
